projectDescription: A Laravel package that sends structured push notifications and API health data to the A-Ray monitoring platform.
keyFeatures: Send structured debug pushes to A-Ray from any Laravel application
Attach multiple commits with status levels (SUCCESS, INFO, WARNING, ERROR) to each push
Automatic error handling integration via Laravel's exception handler
API health monitoring: capture HTTP request/response data via middleware and batch-send on a configurable cron schedule
Sensitive field masking (passwords, tokens) in captured request payloads
Slack error notifications via Laravel's logging channels
Artisan command to batch-send and purge stored API health requests
publicApiSurface: ARayPush::addCommit(string $label, array $content, CommitStatus $status, Carbon $startAt = null): ARayPush
